column1: # Generated by `lake exe oracle calls` (spec/Oracle.lean) from the definition
# in spec/Aontu: calls on numbers, add, sub, mul, div, mod, rem and -( ), each
# under the key v against a document, run in the default mode, without the fill
# (noFill) and under --partial (partial), as `verdict` rows whose expectation is
# the one class `vet` gives, which `vet_iff` makes the definition's own. A call
# whose arguments' normal forms are numbers is the number its function computes
# by the tower's rules (spec/Aontu/Arith.lean); any other call, an argument
# outside the function's domain, a zero divisor, an answer no leaf holds or the
# wrong number of arguments, is an error. The folds sum, least and greatest,
# over a list or a map whose members are numbers, follow from row x129, and +
# from row x300, which waits where it does not take its operands, so that the
# document is incomplete, and join from row x507, which waits on a member or a
# separator not yet settled. pick and sort, which never wait, follow from row
# x597, upper and lower from row x816, translate from row x966, and esc and usc
# from row x1068, super from row x1221, split from row x1332, rep from row
# x1404, nom from row x1521, the components of the component tree from row
# x1677, the generator each, its template read for each member of its data,
# from row x1803, and a filter whose condition holds the hole, read for each
# member it tries, from row x1902. A call skips an optional member whose value
# generates an empty map or list, from row x1935, rep reads its replacement
# against its pattern's groups before the text, from row x1959, pick and sort
# read a projector and a direction through a rider or a mark, from row x1995,
# a string names an index by its digits alone, from row x2025, and translate
# writes U+FFFD for a surrogate its to range names, from row x2055. The generator
# pack, its template read for each member of its data under the member's key,
# follows from row x2064, and key(n), read where it stands, from row x2121. A
# call on a name follows in rows z0 on, and a call handed a pattern, re(p), in
# rows v0 on. path handed a string follows in rows k0 on: its text converted to
# an address, text with no start read from one dot, and refused where it spells
# none, as is any other scalar and a container. abnf and parse follow in rows
# g0 on, over grammars of one rule of one literal, which the oracle's host
# reads as every engine does: abnf answers a grammar's source where it compiles,
# parse(g, v) the tree as data, and parse(g) admits the strings g parses whole.
# The transformer emit follows in rows et0 on, over selections written in place:
# for each node, the body of the first template whose match the node meets,
# read for the node, each list in it spliced, and an error where no template
# matches or the body names what the node doesn't hold. A hole its call's peer
# fills follows in rows hv0 on: a meet with a hole on one side and none on the
# other reads as that side with the hole bound to the other, as the document
# Regenerate with `make spec`; never edit by hand.
